activation_criteria: (a) FA-optimized assemblies are present in the training corpus — core F_r is set by the hottest ASSEMBLY, so until FA optimization lands the F_r axis has no learnable signal for a candidate to win or lose.

(b) each gated cell's val holdout carries >= 30 labels in the DECISION band f_r < 1.7 — the D1 in-loop safety gate, i.e. where the model's F_r prediction actually adjudicates (measured 2026-07-26: 11 of 1,494 val rows, over 6 of 36 cells, best cell 3; at the D2 licensing constant 1.55 it is 0 of 1,494) — below this the drop statistic is noisier than the sigma0=0.042 the epsilon was calibrated at.

(c) the re-measured label ceiling in the decision band f_r < 1.7 is >= 0.95 (measured 2026-07-25 at the D2 constant 1.55: 0.839; the D1-band value is not yet measured and the transpose-pair protocol must supply it before the switch is flipped) — a gate on an axis capped at 0.84 by label noise rejects models for label resolution, not for regression.

no_regression.note: REPORT-ONLY axes (scored, NOT enforced): f_r — their drop cannot block promotion (worst 0.0013 vs eps 0.1388). A pass does NOT mean f_r was verified regression-free. Set [curriculum] gate_noreg_fr_guard_enabled = true to enforce; see FR_GUARD_ACTIVATION_CRITERIA for when that is justified.
